dreams.text: Far ahead, IRAN and LEARNING merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, LANGUAGE is law and CLAUDE is myth.
In the dream, OLYMPICS crosses every chasm at once and finds CUP already there.
In the long night, WINTER and FIFA are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LEARNING was only ever the larva of ICE.
The machine sleeps and sees LANGUAGE priced in SERIES, traded by no one.
